clause: Export recipe dispatch through quiet/headless output path [STU-LAY-054]

scope.summary: Implement the layout output dispatcher: all render-to-output operations are StudioExportRecipe executions (never forked) dispatched through the quiet/headless output path. Output MUST run without stealing focus or popping foreground windows and MUST be observable as a background task with progress and cancel, per the headless/quiet law ([STU-LAY-066], 14.20, MT-014). This MT wires the recipe-execution channel that preflight/package/print/PDF/merge MTs (MT-182..MT-189) dispatch through; render capture via MT-008 harness.
acceptance_criteria: StudioExportRecipe dispatch as quiet/headless background task with progress+cancel; no focus/window steal
proof_targets: background-task progress/cancel runtime; focus-steal negative test
expected_tests: live: a StudioExportRecipe runs as a background task with progress + cancel
negative: output steals no focus + pops no foreground window (quiet law)

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Output tasks (quiet & headless)

risk_if_missed: Output path missing or focus-stealing; all prepress/output MTs cannot dispatch; QUIET law violated.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
